why: The issue only names files that exist at this commit: bin/csv2json.js, src/parse.js, README.md, test/ and the `npm test` script. Its description of the code is accurate. The CLI never reads argv and calls `parse(readFileSync(0,'utf8'))`. parse() defaults `sep = ','`, splits lines on `/\r?\n/` and trims the input. Running TSV through the current code would give `[{"a\tb":"1\t2"}]`, as the issue says, and `parse(text,'\t')` gives `[{a:'1',b:'2'}]`. The README shows only CSV usage. The --tsv flag and a test that uses it are things the issue asks to create, so they don't count against it. The CRLF and no-flag expectations also match what the existing parse logic does. No part of the problem misdescribes the repository.
